summary: Ceragon Networks Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, along with an Operating and Financial Review and Prospects. The filing also includes the consent of its independent registered accounting firms to incorporate by reference their opinion on the company's 2025 Form 20-F financial statements into its Form F-3 registration statement. This is a routine periodic report containing financial results and standard auditor consents, not a special-situation transaction.
